title: Xbox has become a shell of its former self, weighed down by job cuts and studio closures, as it focuses on franchises like Halo and reaching "a billion people" (Andrew Webster/The Verge)
summary: Andrew Webster / The Verge: Xbox has become a shell of its former self, weighed down by job cuts and studio closures, as it focuses on franchises like Halo and reaching “a billion people” — The latest changes at Microsoft's gaming division signal a further retreat from the Xbox brand.
contentText:
Andrew Webster / The Verge :

Xbox has become a shell of its former self, weighed down by job cuts and studio closures, as it focuses on franchises like Halo and reaching “a billion people”   —  ﻿The latest changes at Microsoft's gaming division signal a further retreat from the Xbox brand.
